title: Piercing Statue Duo #014 (데미스탯 · [데미스탯·P8 집중형·에메랄드 그린 유리·메이크업 야미카와] ; [데미스탯·P8 집중형·black granite·메이크업 소피아로렌풍])
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, demi statue portrait. TWO women standing side by side, each angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so every woman's whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually rounded, deliberately carved tips a little further below the middle of her thighs, each face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop. Where a sculpted form comes to an end at the thighs, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off. Generous spacing so every figure reads clearly, nobody's arms crossing a neighbour.

#1: A strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman — pale, almost translucent skin, heavy pink-red eyeshadow smudged wide beneath both eyes like crying, faint tear-track blush running down the cheeks, large dark circle lenses with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy dark-cherry lips, a hollow, half-lidded expression, bold vivid emerald-green hair styled in high ponytail. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#1 Piercings: All eight piercings gather on the left side of her face and ear, and the right side stays bare: on the left ear five pieces — a huge antique-brass hoop hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide antique-brass ear cuff, two smaller antique-brass rings and a small antique-brass stud at the top; two thin antique-brass bars pass through the outer end of the left eyebrow; a small antique-brass ring passes through the left nostril. Each piece carries small pearls set into the metal.
#1 Physique: A colossal, statuesque chest, a broad heavy torso and wide statuesque hips, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped, all on a grand imperial scale.
#1 Body: From the collarbones down, her whole body — shoulders, arms, hands, chest, belly, hips and both distinct thighs — is not painted, covered or clothed but physically made of one solid transparent material, solid clear emerald-green cast glass, with slow internal swirls and tiny bubbles, deep bottle-green where thickest and pale lime at every thin edge, carved as one solid sculpted mass like a statue, never hollow, with no seam and no skin anywhere, every wrist, palm, finger and knuckle the same material. A little further below the middle of her thighs, each thigh individually curves inward and rounded off into its own smooth, deeply polished tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate, never merging into a single base — nothing continues below either tip. Her body below the collarbones is a transparent material that light passes through; her face, ears and neck stay opaque living flesh.

#2: A strikingly beautiful adult Italian woman — warm olive skin, thick strongly arched dark brows, a long black liner winging up and out at the outer corner of each eye, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep red lip with a defined edge, a smouldering, confident expression, warm auburn red-brown hair styled in low bun. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#2 Piercings: All eight piercings gather on the left side of her face and ear, and the right side stays bare: on the left ear five pieces — a huge silver stud hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide silver ear cuff, two smaller silver rings and a small silver stud at the top; two thin silver bars pass through the outer end of the left eyebrow; a small silver ring passes through the left nostril. Each piece carries small amethysts set into the metal.
#2 Physique: A colossal, statuesque chest, a broad heavy torso and wide statuesque hips, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped, all on a grand imperial scale.
#2 Body: From the collarbones down, her whole body — shoulders, arms, hands, chest, belly, hips and both distinct thighs — is not painted, covered or clothed but physically made of one solid opaque stone, solid polished black granite with fine silver flecks and a deep mirror-like sheen, completely opaque, carved as one solid sculpted mass like a statue, never hollow, with no seam and no skin anywhere, every wrist, palm, finger and knuckle the same material. A little further below the middle of her thighs, each thigh individually curves inward and rounded off into its own smooth, deeply polished tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate, never merging into a single base — nothing continues below either tip. Her body below the collarbones is a completely opaque solid that no light passes through; her face, ears and neck are living flesh.

All piercings: All jewelry is real metal, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Boundary for each woman: a sharp jagged line runs around the base of her neck and across both collarbones — real skin above, material immediately below. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step above her flesh, casting a crisp shadow — her skin beside it stays smooth and even. Each rounded tip is that material's own carved finish — never the edge of a photograph. Shards interlock along the collarbone line only.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind them washed with two coloured lights from behind — a pale lilac on one side and a soft mint on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath them.

Pose: each stands tall, her left hand resting on her flared hip, her right arm held clear of her body with the hand relaxed at hip height, every hand well away from every face, heads tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: the glowing backdrop floods every transparent body from behind, tinting it, while the opaque bodies block it completely and are lit by two large softboxes raking from either side. A soft frontal light falls on all the faces and ears; a thin cool rim light traces every figure. Only each woman's face, ears and neck read as real skin. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
